text:
noah: hey all, i'm noah (first day on eng-sre) :wave: hit a wall with observability access. Grafana opens after SSO but a few dashboards are missing, and Datadog redirects to Okta then shows 'You are not authorized'. who grants the infra dashboards access?

anya: welcome noah :tada: sorry about that. paste your Okta email and i'll start the entitlement requests. Grafana viewer + Datadog read are the usual defaults for new eng-sre folks.

noah: noah.burns@redwood.com

identity-bot: identity-bot created ticket IDP-3899 for noah.burns@redwood.com: "Entitlement mapping failure for Redwood Datadog and Grafana". Assigned: anya.

anya: thanks. quick checks: try incognito to clear SSO cookies; if Datadog still 403 it's usually the Okta group->Datadog team mapping (SCIM). i'll request the Grafana invite and queue the Datadog team add.

infra-bot: infra-bot sent Grafana invite to noah.burns@redwood.com (expires in 7 days). INFRA-3420 created to add to Datadog team 'inference-observability'.

noah: accepted Grafana invite, can view a bunch of dashboards but can't find 'model-costs-by-region' or 'p95-by-model' in the infra folder. search turns up nothing.

anya: some dashboards live in restricted folders or were created with restricted ACLs. i'll grant folder view for infra and reindex search. If the dashboard is not present it's possible it's only in Datadog and imported into Grafana via the Datadog datasource.

identity-bot: identity-bot: Datadog team add queued (IDP-3899 -> SCIM sync). Expected completion: ~2h depending on SCIM queue.

noah: Datadog still 403 after 30m. any way to escalate? i need to validate cost queries this afternoon.

anya: i've flagged priority on INFRA-3420 and pinged identity for a manual sync. Also, if you can share the exact dashboard slugs i can check whether they exist in the repo (infra/grafana/dashboards) or only in Datadog.

noah: slugs per the onboarding doc: infra/model-costs-by-region and infra/p95-by-model.

infra-bot: infra-bot: folder ACL updated for noah.burns@redwood.com -> folder: infra (viewer).

ops-oncall: quick FYI: to get paged you need to be added to the PagerDuty escalation policy for the service. file a request in #people-ops-support with the service name and reason. We'll add you after a short runbook walkthrough.

identity-bot: manual SCIM sync performed for IDP-3899. Datadog team membership applied to noah.burns@redwood.com.

noah: confirmed Datadog works now! i can see monitors and the cost dashboards. Found the model-costs-by-region dashboard in Grafana after the reindex. All set :thumbsup: Thanks for the quick turnaround.

anya: welcome aboard! added a note to the new-hire checklist: expect Grafana invites <1h, Datadog SCIM group sync usually <2h but manual syncs may be needed. Sentry requires security review and 2FA before accepting. If you want edit rights on a Grafana dashboard open a PR against infra/grafana/dashboards and include a short justification.

noah: one last question 283 how do i propose a default time window tweak on p95-by-model? small change to focus on 7d instead of 30d.

anya: open a PR with the exported dashboard JSON and a brief rationale. Tag eng-sre and eng-runtime reviewers; minor visual tweaks usually merge within a day. If it's needed for an active incident, ping oncall and we can make a temporary change and follow up with a PR.

noah: perfect, i'll open that PR. thanks again everyone :heart:
